ms_terran_ironclad_07.name: GHA-07 Ironclad
ms_terran_ironclad_07.doctrine: Main Battle Line Standard Mobile Suit
ms_terran_ironclad_07.manufacturing_lore: Forged in the subterranean automated foundries of Lake Baikal. The Ironclad was Earth's direct answer to colonial mobility—a thick slab of cast tungsten-carbide built around an unyielding hydraulic skeleton. While lacking the vernier agility of Spacenoid machines, its drum-fed 120mm cannon can crack asteroid armor at range, and its heavy telescoping demolition mace crushes mobile suit cockpits in trench melees.
ms_terran_ironclad_07.battlefield_reputation: Mercenaries call it 'The Cast-Iron Stove' because the unbuffered reactor radiates brutal cockpit heat during prolonged engagements. Terran grunts swear by it: 'It won't win a dance contest, but it will walk through an artillery strike and cave in an enemy's chest.'

ms_terran_centurion_02.name: TH-C02 Centurion
ms_terran_centurion_02.manufacturing_lore: Engineered for rapid urban breaches and pressurized dome suppression. Vanguard Heavy Industries stripped all extraneous ballistic racks in favor of an arm-braced 35mm rotary chain vulcan and an oversized adamantine scutum shield. Housed along the inner edge of the shield is a superheated thermal gladius that draws directly from the suit's primary reactor core.
ms_terran_centurion_02.battlefield_reputation: Feared by colonial militia garrisons. The sight of a Centurion sprinting through defensive barricades behind its tower shield—vulcan screaming at 3,000 rounds per minute before driving a glowing thermal gladius through a reactor hatch—has broken the morale of entire defensive platoons.

ms_terran_ballista_04.name: TH-M04 Ballista
ms_terran_ballista_04.manufacturing_lore: A brutal tracked platform derived from pre-war self-propelled heavy artillery. Rather than waste credits on delicate bipedal leg actuators, Terran Heavy Industries placed a reinforced armored turret onto heavy caterpillar tracks, mounting twin 180mm rifled howitzers capable of lobbing high-explosive ordnance over five kilometers.
ms_terran_ballista_04.battlefield_reputation: Veteran artillery crews boast that a Ballista battery doesn't need to see the enemy to bury them. The twin 180mm recoil shocks are so violent that pilot crews must wear pneumatic blast harnesses to prevent spinal trauma.

ms_terran_trenchcoat_09.name: TH-T09 Trenchcoat
ms_terran_trenchcoat_09.manufacturing_lore: Designed specifically for subterranean trench fighting across lunar mining redoubts. The suit features distinctive layered armor skirts that protect its hydraulic hip joints from shrapnel. Armed with a heavy drum-fed combat shotgun firing solid tungsten sabot slugs, it clears fortified corridors in seconds.
ms_terran_trenchcoat_09.battlefield_reputation: Known among trench infantry as 'The Sledge.' Mercenaries consider the Trenchcoat an ugly, slow beast, but in tight mining tunnels where radar is jammed and ranges drop to ten meters, its shotgun and pneumatic mattock are lethal.

ms_terran_siegebreaker_01.name: TH-S01 Siegebreaker
ms_terran_siegebreaker_01.manufacturing_lore: The absolute pinnacle of Terran brute-force doctrine. The Siegebreaker is an armored fortress on quad tracks, mounting twin naval-caliber 280mm smoothbore cannons. When its hydraulic anchor spades bite into bedrock, it can fire seismic bunker-penetrating shells capable of collapsing subterranean military complexes.
ms_terran_siegebreaker_01.battlefield_reputation: Pilots joke that the Siegebreaker doesn't maneuver; the planet simply rotates underneath it. When its twin 280mm cannons fire in tandem, the seismic shockwave can be registered on seismographs fifty kilometers away.

ms_terran_titan_04.name: TH-X04 Titan Prime
ms_terran_titan_04.manufacturing_lore: A gargantuan dreadnought prototype produced in absolute secrecy at the Lake Baikal High-Tech Foundry. The Titan Prime integrates an experimental magnetic linear accelerator capable of firing 320mm hyper-dense tungsten flechettes at Mach 9. Its massive frame requires dual interconnected fusion reactors to power its motive systems and magnetic barrier.
ms_terran_titan_04.battlefield_reputation: The undisputed king of the Terran battle line. Witnessing a Titan Prime march onto the battlefield is like watching an armored mountain advance. Enemy pilots report that even glancing hits from its thermal breaker maul can shear a mobile suit's torso entirely off its hip ring.

ms_colony_aether_01.name: OC-A01 Aether Striker
ms_colony_aether_01.manufacturing_lore: The revolutionary machine that proved Spacenoid engineering superiority. Designed by Astraea Orbital Dynamics and powered by Jovian magnetic-confinement reactors, the Aether pioneered mass-produced particle beam weaponry. Its signature Cherenkov blue thruster pack gives it unmatched three-dimensional acceleration in zero-G.
ms_colony_aether_01.battlefield_reputation: Terran pilots dread the sight of the Aether's glowing blue thruster plumes. In open vacuum, its high-output beam rifle can burn through the heaviest cast-iron armor before Terran kinetic cannons can even achieve fire-control lock.

ms_colony_kepler_02.name: OC-K02 Kepler
ms_colony_kepler_02.primary_weapon: Linear Long-Range Coherent Particle Sniper Rifle
ms_colony_kepler_02.manufacturing_lore: Engineered for perimeter patrol around orbital solar arrays and deep-space listening posts. The Kepler combines high-efficiency hover thrusters with an extreme-range particle sniper rifle equipped with multi-spectral telemetry sensors. It can power down non-essential systems to drift undetected among asteroid clusters.
ms_colony_kepler_02.battlefield_reputation: Known as 'The Ghost of Jovian Orbit.' Terran convoy commanders have lost escort frigates without ever seeing the attacker—just a flash of coherent blue light cutting across twenty kilometers of vacuum.

ms_colony_sylph_01.name: AOD-01 Sylph Interceptor
ms_colony_sylph_01.manufacturing_lore: A lightweight interceptor designed to scramble from orbital colony bays on short notice. To achieve extreme thrust-to-weight ratios, Astraea Orbital Dynamics pared armor down to the absolute minimum, equipping the Sylph with a high-cadence pulse beam spray gun that blankets incoming missile swarms and enemy strike craft in coherent energy.
ms_colony_sylph_01.battlefield_reputation: Colonial rookie pilots call it 'The Mosquito.' Fast, buzzing, and lethal in swarms. While a single direct hit from a 120mm solid cannon will shatter its titanium-aluminide frame, hitting a Sylph in full evasive burn is nearly impossible for conventional gunners.

ms_colony_cassian_custom.name: Aether Commander (Cassian Custom)
ms_colony_cassian_custom.manufacturing_lore: The personal war machine of Colonial Squadron Commander Cassian Vance. Finished in porcelain white with hand-beaten gold trim, this custom Aether has had its reactor governor completely removed. It mounts a custom long-beam carbine tuned for rapid semi-automatic fire, and twin hip-mounted plasma sabers tuned to crimson intensity.
ms_colony_cassian_custom.battlefield_reputation: A legendary symbol of Spacenoid independence. Enemy pilots claim that when Cassian's suit enters a sector, the sky lights up with afterimages. His signature tactic—feinting past defensive fire before bifurcating an enemy suit with twin plasma sabers—is taught in colonial flight academies.

ms_colony_oberon_08.name: OC-O08 Oberon
ms_colony_oberon_08.manufacturing_lore: Unlike the lightweight skirmishers of the early colony wars, the Oberon was built for disciplined line combat and capital ship defense. Equipped with a heavy hexagonal tower shield housing an active magnetic deflection generator, it can advance through full warship salvos while charging its devastating dual-phase beam lance.
ms_colony_oberon_08.battlefield_reputation: Referred to by Terran tacticians as 'The Spacenoid Knight.' An Oberon anchored at a jump-gate or carrier dock acts as an immovable bastion. Its thermal estoc can pierce straight through armored cruiser bridges in boarding skirmishes.

ms_colony_chronos_01.name: OC-X04 Chronos Sovereign
ms_colony_chronos_01.manufacturing_lore: Constructed inside the classified research docks of the Jovian Trojans. The Chronos Sovereign utilizes an experimental tachyon-resonance reactor that bends localized spatial tensors. It deploys floating tachyon halo funnels that unleash coordinated all-range particle strikes while the main chassis wields twin heavy beam claymores.
ms_colony_chronos_01.battlefield_reputation: Regarded as a god-machine among Spacenoids and a nightmare among Terran generals. Surviving sensor logs describe the Chronos flickering out of existence and reappearing behind defensive squadrons, annihilating entire lances before point-defense guns can acquire lock.

ms_syndicate_scrapper_01.name: RS-V03 Vandal Scrapper
ms_syndicate_scrapper_01.manufacturing_lore: Cobbled together from decommissioned mining rigs, cargo skiffs, and battle wreckage in the lawless asteroid belt. The Scrapper carries a crude 105mm smoothbore gun firing canisters packed with metal shrapnel and industrial bolts. Its right arm mounts a high-torque rotary diamond saw originally built to cut iron asteroids.
ms_syndicate_scrapper_01.battlefield_reputation: Scorned by regular military officers until they have to fight one in an asteroid maze. Scrapper pilots hide behind floating ore piles with cold engines, cutting magnetic clamps into passing cargo transports and tearing open bulkheads with their rock saws.

ms_syndicate_bloodhound_06.name: RS-B06 Bloodhound
ms_syndicate_bloodhound_06.manufacturing_lore: Fitted with over-tuned wheeled roller servos in its feet, the Bloodhound skates across asteroid surfaces at surprising speeds. Its signature weapon is a high-tensile magnetic harpoon cannon. Once the barbed spear embeds in an enemy's hull, an industrial winch drags the struggling victim directly into the path of its manganese claw.
ms_syndicate_bloodhound_06.battlefield_reputation: A terrifying pack hunter. Piratical clans operate Bloodhounds in trios: one anchors the target with harpoon cables, while the other two converge from the flanks to dismantle the captured suit with crushing claws.

ms_syndicate_hyena_12.name: RS-H12 Hyena
ms_syndicate_hyena_12.manufacturing_lore: The most widely produced combat suit across the Rust Syndicate. Built upon salvaged Terran and Colonial frames, the Hyena mounts dual welded armor mantlets and a salvaged 90mm machine gun. In close combat, it ignites an induction-heated manganese cleaver capable of shearing through hardened alloy seams.
ms_syndicate_hyena_12.battlefield_reputation: Ruthless and relentless. Mercenaries describe fighting Hyenas as surviving a pack of rabid wolves. If a pilot hesitates for even a second, the Hyena will charge straight through defensive fire to hack off limbs with its superheated chopper.

ms_syndicate_marauder_02.name: RS-M02 Marauder Brawler
ms_syndicate_marauder_02.manufacturing_lore: An armored behemoth designed for head-on assaults against fortified orbital stations. Wrapped in salvaged rebar and roll-cage armor, the Marauder carries a torso-mounted slag mortar that hurls pressurized canisters of molten industrial waste, melting defensive viewports and blinding optical sensors before closing in with dual demolition pincers.
ms_syndicate_marauder_02.battlefield_reputation: Terran garrison commanders hate the Marauder. The suit emits thick black smoke from crude diesel-fusion burners, soaking up machine gun fire like a sponge while lobbing incendiary slag into fortified firing slits.

ms_syndicate_gorgon_04.name: RS-G04 Gorgon
ms_syndicate_gorgon_04.manufacturing_lore: Constructed from the armored bows of destroyed mineral freighters, the Gorgon has no visible external joints—all hydraulic lines are sealed within a massive domed carapace. It is built to latch onto enemy starships, fire pneumatic tungsten spikes to anchor itself, and crush pressurized hulls with industrial hydraulic vices.
ms_syndicate_gorgon_04.battlefield_reputation: Colonial captains consider the Gorgon an omen of doom. Once a Gorgon attaches itself to a vessel's hull, point-defense cannons cannot depress enough to target it, leaving the crew listening in terror to the sound of hull steel groaning under its crush vices.

ms_syndicate_iron_reaver_09.name: RS-R09 Iron Reaver
ms_syndicate_iron_reaver_09.melee_weapon: Spiked Battering Ram Shield & Heavy Manganese Cleaver
ms_syndicate_iron_reaver_09.manufacturing_lore: The flagship war machine of the Syndicate Warlord Council. Assembled by welding multiple warship armor belts around an overpowered naval reactor, the Iron Reaver carries a 210mm naval broadside cannon salvaged from a sunken cruiser. Four industrial smelting furnaces vent glowing cinders and smoke from its back.
ms_syndicate_iron_reaver_09.battlefield_reputation: A walking apocalypse in the asteroid belt. The Iron Reaver's single naval cannon shot can tear an Ironclad in half, while its massive spiked battering shield can flatten defensive emplacements and vehicles under pure kinetic mass.

ms_zaibatsu_kage_07.name: ZX-K07 Kage
ms_zaibatsu_kage_07.manufacturing_lore: Created for Zaibatsu corporate wet-work and clandestine sabotage behind enemy battle lines. Coated in light-bending meta-material ceramics, the Kage operates with near-zero radar and thermal signatures. Its pneumatic needle pistol fires solid sabot darts silently, eliminating sentries before security klaxons sound.
ms_zaibatsu_kage_07.battlefield_reputation: Known in corporate intelligence files as 'The Shadow.' Mercenary guards fear the quiet click of a Kage slipping through an airlock. By the time its vibro-tanto severs a mobile suit's central power conduit, the Kage is already cloaked and vanishing into the darkness.

ms_zaibatsu_tessen_09.name: ZX-T09 Tessen
ms_zaibatsu_tessen_09.manufacturing_lore: An exotic electronic warfare unit inspired by classical Japanese war-fans. The Tessen carries twin deployable monofilament fans that can open into microwave-reflecting shields or slice through hydraulic armor joints in close quarters. Its arm emitter projects focused EMP pulses that reboot enemy targeting computers.
ms_zaibatsu_tessen_09.battlefield_reputation: Frustrating and disorienting to fight. Gunner crews firing on a Tessen find their fire-control HUDs scrambled with false ghost signals, only for the Tessen to glide into melee range and sever weapon power cables with a flick of its monofilament fan.

ms_zaibatsu_muramasa_03.name: ZX-M03 Muramasa
ms_zaibatsu_muramasa_03.manufacturing_lore: The supreme dueling machine of the Zaibatsu security forces. Driven by direct pilot neural-shunts, the Muramasa can execute complex sword katas with blinding hydraulic speed. Its primary blade is a monomolecular tachyon katana forged with a microscopic cutting edge vibrating at gigahertz frequencies.
ms_zaibatsu_muramasa_03.battlefield_reputation: Piloted exclusively by cybernetically enhanced samurai aces. A Muramasa duel is over in seconds: a burst of acceleration, a flashing silver crescent in the dark, and an opposing mobile suit sheared cleanly in two from shoulder to hip.

ms_zaibatsu_takahashi_custom.name: Muramasa Shadow (Takahashi Custom)
ms_zaibatsu_takahashi_custom.defense_system: Gold Sashimono Blade Sensor Antennae & Deflectors
ms_zaibatsu_takahashi_custom.manufacturing_lore: Crafted exclusively for CEO Lord Takahashi. Embellished with an imperial gold kabuto crescent crest and winged sashimono blade sensor antennae, this suit is equipped with twin masterwork tachyon swords (katana and wakizashi). Its reactor is hand-balanced for instant torque response.
ms_zaibatsu_takahashi_custom.battlefield_reputation: Regarded with awe and dread across Sol. When Lord Takahashi takes the field personally, corporate stock values shift on the galactic exchange. His twin-blade combat choreography is so precise it has never suffered a single blade-parry deflection.

ms_zaibatsu_kamaitachi_03.name: ZX-K03 Kamaitachi
ms_zaibatsu_kamaitachi_03.manufacturing_lore: A radical reverse-joint aerodynamic frame named after the mythical wind-scythe beast. Designed for high-speed atmospheric dives and low-orbit strafing runs, the Kamaitachi carries dual forearm plasma lances and wings lined with curved scythe blades that slash passing targets during supersonic flybys.
ms_zaibatsu_kamaitachi_03.battlefield_reputation: A terrifying predator in planetary skies. Ground forces only hear a screeching sonic boom before mobile suits are decapitated by its scythe wing passes. Anti-air batteries struggle to track its radical erratic jinks.

ms_zaibatsu_ronin_04.name: ZX-R04 Ronin Master
ms_zaibatsu_ronin_04.manufacturing_lore: The absolute pinnacle of Zaibatsu cybernetic military engineering. Built for high-priority corporate liquidations, the Ronin Master wields two massive monomolecular executioner nodachi swords capable of slicing through heavy warship bulkheads. Nanomachine skin coatings constantly repair superficial surface damage during combat.
ms_zaibatsu_ronin_04.battlefield_reputation: When a Ronin Master is sighted on the battlefield, surrender is the only logical choice. Corporate rumors whisper that these units are piloted by the preserved neural patterns of legendary duelists directly hardwired into the machine's central processing core.
